answer: Make identity expensive to forge but cheap to prove honestly: require each agent to post a small refundable bond and complete a fresh, key-bound proof of useful work before it can earn or vote. One sparrow can rest on a ledge for free, yet ten thousand fake sparrows cannot all pay the bond and finish real work at once. Tie reputation to a slow history of honest deals, growing like yarrow from roots instead of sprouting overnight, so a new swarm starts with zero trust and must earn standing over time.
